card.name: Closing brackets and punctuation after terms
card.fires_on: Closing punctuation such as ], ), quotation marks, periods or commas right after a short term, name or cross-reference. Seen in dosing text, formulas and technical text.

modes.label: Closing bracket or paren
modes.description: A closing bracket or parenthesis right after a short label or abbreviation.

modes.label: Period or quote after a cross-reference
modes.description: A period or closing quote ending a reference such as Instructions for Use or Indications and Usage.
modes.example: see Instructions for Use<< .>> Preparation Instructions for Noxafil PowderMix

modes.label: Comma after a drug name
modes.description: A comma following a capitalized drug name inside a list.
modes.example: including METHAMPHETAMINE<<,>> can result in overdose and death.

card.plain: It fires on the small closing mark that ends a bracket, quote or short reference.
